![IMG_4541.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belug/Eoc6XxZH9g6BHsuYGxbe476QH5K6sptSKLqM2D9rZBgnCYfuUj6au4EhTU6mjR33jLG.jpeg)
### English _______ # The White Temple in Thailand: What sort of temple is it? Is it worth a visit or not? ______ Thailand’s famous White Temple (Wat Rong Khun), designed by Chalermchai Kositpipat and located in Chiang Rai, is a rather special place. Actually, I went there on a day trip and it turned out to be quite a surprise. I thought there would be loads of people going there for religious or spiritual reasons to pray; seeing it so white, so big and so elaborate, I thought it was a huge tribute to Buddha. However, I found something very different—something that, at least to me, seemed suspicious and strange. Not only did it go beyond the conventional boundaries of religion, but it also featured characters that have nothing to do with Buddhism or the spiritual world of light. For example, you could see images of Pikachu, Superman, or Batman—characters I’ll be discussing throughout this post and that you can also see in the photos. In fact, the ones that were most prominent were inside one of the main structures, where taking pictures was prohibited.
### Español ______ > # El Templo Blanco de Tailandia: ¿Un templo a qué? ¿Vale o no la pena visitarlo? ________ > El conocido Templo Blanco de Tailandia (Wat Rong Khun), diseñado por Chalermchai Kositpipat y que se encuentra en Chiang Rai, es un sitio particular. En realidad, fui a este lugar en una excursión y resultó ser toda una sorpresa. Yo pensaba que habría muchísima gente yendo por una cuestión religiosa o espiritual a rezar; al verlo tan blanco, tan grande y tan elaborado, creí que era una enorme alabanza a Buda. > Sin embargo, me encontré con algo muy diferente, de una forma que al menos a mí me pareció sospechosa y extraña. No solamente excedía lo convencional de una religión, sino que además introducía personajes que nada tienen que ver con el budismo ni con el mundo espiritual de la luz. Por ejemplo, se podían ver imágenes de Pikachu, Superman o Batman; personajes que a lo largo de este post voy a estar comentándoles y que también pueden observar en las fotos. De hecho, los que más estaban presentes se encontraban dentro de una de las estructuras principales, donde estaba prohibido capturar imágenes.
________________________ ![IMG_4580.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belug/EpNnubfqVyhL3kimjkyLMvCrfKwxYmNRLbSnZkBkEeMuzL17sv5x94BtnJk5XJrh7cp.jpeg) ![IMG_4556.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belug/Eonj2rZT4VcmwwMVkizNy3TnJtrUtxrAYYCPUwt9vpwDVEfhntQCeaEMWuaH8hEkdbh.jpeg) ![IMG_4617.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belug/Ep5mEqDLpb2KpPyvdRg4zQrpo86wSHitarPNcSotBNdUHNLUScLs8TxMNkFFoQyo2Vf.jpeg) ![IMG_4560.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belug/EowF7htinHg33GQkj6EGSX95r17ZP6o8CMkECiQ4hc8F9cyq5B5Vr5viriip5GSu5zh.jpeg) ![IMG_4589.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belug/EqDihsjc9TsdomyS6BHTQPpc5Di24aeUWWXNiWpzNrrL4LazQTMxDYxh962ybYnkoRN.jpeg) ![IMG_4578.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belug/EonkbXUGJwEUqfRJwMjNWJcD4UhApkThy4vJMS5ZdXnnZHQMsoBVhV2A3J4Tx4r1Hhy.jpeg) ![IMG_4628.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belug/EoyPUQ6zyXqM1sm93ag2sQDAGy5Li3N5kTUfjFike7EqXn1AqZFUr8AoDab1DTkjjfs.jpeg) ![IMG_4621.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belug/23xVKE6zWHMJhwAzYHmNhTaJezUxyieJjrpH2QctxGGgVtD3NdudnEeXPjDpdAo9UBAHD.jpeg) ![IMG_4543.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belug/EoyMaR5qo7aaqrzmnWjgUpfTj5uQmVYWQpawGsdRLLARqfj3DwFnFVWvwJAfAmy1aRK.jpeg) ![IMG_4593.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belug/EoCgjMRTvVA6kV9Vq5nQLHe5gnNGebPWGqsTibMnpcWWqFuJPcQZYQ7TLgfdLDbjcFj.jpeg) ![IMG_4626.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belug/EoK5nbbFrpDmPhZn5SHKyLZkFADpUFXTwpETb82tZoGaTRWArf9AJ6tGJb86vyLWnLU.jpeg) _______________
Even outside the venue, there were certain displays that were a bit jarring for my taste: the head of a human or an astronaut being devoured by an alien, upside-down skulls, and monsters. As I became more familiar with the site, people explained to me that all of this alluded to modern consumerism, to the shadow and the light that exist in life itself. It’s a natural part of existence, and I believe you can’t ignore the darkness; still, this concept and these figures, crafted with such precision, ended up feeling like a kind of trap to me.
> Incluso fuera del recinto había ciertas representaciones un poco ensordecedoras para mi gusto: la cabeza de un humano o astronauta siendo devorada por un extraterrestre, calaveras invertidas y monstruos. A medida que avancé en el conocimiento del sitio, me fueron comentando que todo eso hacía alusión al consumismo actual, a la sombra y a la luz que hay en la misma vida. Es algo natural que existe, y considero que no se puede obviar la oscuridad; de todas maneras, este concepto y estas figuras elaboradas con tanta precisión me terminaron pareciendo una especie de trampa.
___________ ![IMG_4584.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belug/Eq9Uk7Lv8j6roPGsFRZ4FAbkj7fZXriu3yG9kVVsEaPQTD7vVgrfM8MEc5iyqvA8KJy.jpeg) ![IMG_4564.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belug/243fp3CvfUNBrQCJgFMR47QNgsczdr9kMRW1Xy3nP2wbfXnWLYEZiFoec5EpqSAmim37J.jpeg) ![IMG_4588.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belug/EoiVdJWJsH8vgFjFK41z72SRFbQG83u3Lb5d1mScm8seJgQP4iYstY16fasoCM3143d.jpeg) ![IMG_4631.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belug/23zGXyTWAx8AgXXcZmcfeRvmbgmWYqyfjzQZDRuuZrs3r2NK2632fgBERGowd6GX5izj6.jpeg) ![IMG_4579.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belug/Eoc6ahHBbCi8UccaUy9vNtAM6ZggWGmA7kHCZuq2rXa6URMZsxmWfSAka37hZS1YW4k.jpeg) ![IMG_4623.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belug/242XwP58GVhU7S7Rx7SQTPKotKfY9MFhK6ew9PWRtHUnjH7QE8wgct9WvFz78msqUkTtT.jpeg) ![IMG_4539.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belug/Eos1Na7kM8F32G7ptANFVqREQze8NVwYGjFX3CNDkdKzrkYTEnrpcsSg4pcBMKmeUNF.jpeg) ![IMG_4595.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belug/Eoc7TbBoBAXxPt4FjQQB5R6CCbPmgJEktRwqaBTx5b7So2pyVyx276zRUFvPLd3Wb7k.jpeg) ![IMG_4620.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belug/23uQvSdkFD3W7peR7pzMaLFGKcppwTSs6mHFZh5ZmoWfwgoAkHnKx6nLoNg7rWzePn7QE.jpeg) ![IMG_4553.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belug/EpNnPE3njhswxEn55QDcN5oN1aoAUevNuKhZiiQsqUBMUgG6qmqdv9eSEjsG3T3ddAS.jpeg) ![IMG_4570.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belug/Eq5CXiM2qgexgqw9abAfKfBEtTViQy7vwy9ohjFop3fMcnPrKYPVqByiXpH12aukiex.jpeg) ![IMG_4571.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belug/EowFCWwp93nyyS4JDhS3TFEEqxWKStoAbJWap6HjUWFngGT4ma5UrWX8YpA9mqNdiHE.jpeg) ___________________
While we can’t ignore the dark side, I believe this is a way of praising it. My analysis may sound a bit harsh or controversial, but that’s the feeling it gave me. If we build a temple to worship Buddha or deities like Ganesha, it would make sense to surround ourselves with the energies we wish to revere. If, on the other hand, we place amorphous, alien faces and death, I wonder what we are actually worshiping. For this reason, it struck me as a facade; a covert way of attracting crowds by displaying something bright and illuminated on the outside—as often happens in life—only for you to realize in the end that you’re there for another reason. Perhaps you were looking for a giant Buddha, but you end up surrounded by deformed masks that speak to the degradation of human light.
> Si bien no se puede ignorar la parte sombría, creo que esta es una manera de alabarla. Quizás suena un poco duro o polémico mi análisis, pero es la sensación que me generó. Si se hace un templo para venerar a Buda o a deidades como Ganesha, lo lógico sería rodearnos de esas energías a las que queremos adorar. Si en cambio colocamos rostros amorfos, extraterrestres y muerte, me pregunto a qué le estamos rindiendo culto. Por este motivo, me pareció una fachada; una forma encubierta de atraer multitudes mostrando por fuera algo iluminado y brillante, como muchas veces pasa en la vida, para que al final te des cuenta de que estás ahí por otro motivo. Tal vez buscabas un Buda gigante, pero terminás rodeada de máscaras deformadas que hablan de la degradación de la luz humana.
__________ ![IMG_4614.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belug/EoptpKZjHvCJJbR9q8jPTasxo7WNfJjQnxBNvoopW2Ghuu4TeYHNNJfUuNinvJFuUgr.jpeg) ![IMG_4608.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belug/23uQiAjAVg1HnKNCL6trQ9kjgkKpKKodmU61nU5tpQha4k6SzNmVKE3CRR8XLRiaT2bpU.jpeg) ![IMG_4609.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belug/23tkov7EXvevcBhCyjVi4uMQw2oSWFL787ufvE6LkDBjzoGfoznh8cbwmRxDTbKZq8WSH.jpeg) ![IMG_4607.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belug/23wqEYZUZC6yLSYzT49kckN6dm7vTMxnFRmcdcksJRrAvRxMcegesvUFBLfxb8SZEgxX6.jpeg) ![IMG_4612.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belug/EoiUoF3bFt3pxjcq7wvihUtdS5yMfQ8BZYFh9TxPqWuv74GLD3PphJT242ZTfVZFGT3.jpeg) ![IMG_4601.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belug/EorzLJLtcwuL3SqM7f6eSfQ9JeUVN3jZsW6mDcP9k6QJ7XvVutVx5zwcE2fPPjCpUjY.jpeg) ![IMG_4602.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belug/EoiVkpkGwQ5fLm6HsSAkxdNvRPgJMbCrRCQBTjDUBFx9JZfdJzdSiLTFCAeunzLvkm8.jpeg) ![IMG_4600.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belug/EoK4qEx7JU95xwpWH4gibLbyKR4Ng9i3jMpHHpBmQvtNMKSEQCLzJs3Kyc4F3JRiX5J.jpeg) ![IMG_4615.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belug/EoCbQWV5WW4uze3qN1kD17icnkkbTwbsk85B3KsJoPoTMjvRGrMXby5xygVfmx8xhhW.jpeg) _______________
Setting aside this perspective—which may be a bit pessimistic and colored by my own subjectivity and spiritual journey—the White Temple is definitely very beautiful in its design. It’s gorgeous, but I’ll say it again: to reach the brightest part, you had to walk down a path lined with depictions of corpses. Even though they were made of stone and everything looked white, the images weren’t pleasant. If you ask me whether I recommend going, I’d say it depends. In my case, if I had known this beforehand, I wouldn’t have gone. But if you don’t mind that subliminal message, the place is aesthetically incredible. Plus, there’s a cavern where the space starts to narrow and continues to display the same imagery—there are even Ninja Turtles carved into the rock. At the end of that cave, you come upon a Buddha that speaks to that journey through darkness to reach enlightenment.
> Fuera de esta mirada, que quizás sea un poco pesimista y cargada con mi propia subjetividad y camino espiritual, el Templo Blanco es definitivamente muy bonito en su diseño. Es precioso, pero reitero: para llegar a la parte más iluminada, tenías que pasar por un camino donde abajo había representaciones de cadáveres. Aunque estaban hechos de piedra y todo se veía blanco, las imágenes no eran agradables. > Si me preguntan si es recomendable ir, yo diría que depende. En mi caso, si hubiese sabido esto de antemano, no habría ido. Pero si no te importa ese mensaje subliminal, el lugar estéticamente es increíble. Además, cuenta con una caverna donde el sitio se empieza a estrechar y sigue mostrando lo mismo: incluso hay Tortugas Ninja esculpidas en roca. Al final de esa cueva se llega a ver un Buda que habla de ese tránsito por la oscuridad para alcanzar la iluminación.
________ ![IMG_4568.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belug/EpEGsEjEwB2doCjVChoP5Ju3JBZfxXMEx9KMjuM9YbTSLr6keyWG7vKh8K7DW7ysBx9.jpeg) ![IMG_4579.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belug/Eoc6ahHBbCi8UccaUy9vNtAM6ZggWGmA7kHCZuq2rXa6URMZsxmWfSAka37hZS1YW4k.jpeg) ![IMG_4559.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belug/EoGyrG3UAGANe9uWBgRzorG7L8PweDvTawJbkYmmYVDCwhKjbVoroUNdipAfhiXG5fn.jpeg) ![IMG_4557.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belug/EpGPL44Q2XC6nUWJJQgCHi1tiw3u34mYNQPMpnyE9aZgV6N6TgqpWqDt5V5hLB8x9Y9.jpeg) ![IMG_4548.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belug/Ep1Vy8zsxUuFJGzJ3GsTr7huabLU9FBj5Rw54hiMQnRbmjae2FnqgUXjjUStjT2CBNt.jpeg) ![IMG_4641.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belug/EppJnAbuFC82Srjsr9MGZw2dzppVF282wtB7cH1uG8FfoJW55UWwNKmfRZNQaQcLJMn.jpeg) ![IMG_4552.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belug/EpEGpXfepKkF5C8p39m57AsdqxgtPUzonrzXecuK3FiDobG7W2muCBtEUP7bB6xmRcd.jpeg) ![IMG_4596.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belug/EpC8smaqpbRfUww2FSqmVf25GjzqemDqtHsX6mGzPAd9NPqtmgtY7tXwFaGPdAu5e7Z.jpeg) ________
For me, it’s a Thai classic—a must-see—but if you look at it from a spiritual perspective, it’s something to think about. I’m glad I went because it made me realize there were many similar things in the country; I didn’t see it that way in Vietnam, but here I felt that sometimes they promoted the light only to end up leading you to see the shadow. I hope you enjoyed this review; it might not be the most positive, but it’s my way of introducing a very famous site. I’d love to read your thoughts and hear what you thought of my post. Thank you so much for being here.
> Para mí es un clásico de Tailandia, una visita que hay que hacer, pero si le ponés peso espiritual, está para pensarlo. Agradezco haber ido porque así me di cuenta de que había muchas cosas similares en el país; no lo vi así en Vietnam, pero aquí sentí que a veces se promocionaba la luz para terminar llevándote a ver la sombra. Espero que les haya gustado esta reseña; quizás no es la más positiva, pero es mi manera de introducir un sitio muy famoso. Me gustaría leer sus opiniones y saber qué les generó mi publicación. My mom always used to say "if you just take and take, without ever putting anything back, one day there will be nothing left to take". She used to say this to us, to prepare us for the big life that was expecting us, as adults. She had many sayings like this and even though it wasn't yesterday, I still remember many of them and I'm thankful to her. PeakD has an amazing feature which is the notification and reminder of new proposals, so you can take action. This week such a notification popped up on my screen about a new proposal, so I went to check it out as knew nothing about the proposal owner. Since then, both the post and the proposal were deleted and removed, so don't go look for it, but I'll tell you briefly what it was about. ![sebastian-schuster-2W3LGMboVB8-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23uQpei8vPy59mYrkz7NXJztHPKa4GhgjEZ68AzPsMRjEW3cct5xjtnSwCtBue1dMAmek.jpg) Photo by Sebastian Schuster on Unsplash Someone who allegedly has been doing some dev works for Hive, which is amazing (he got paid for it by the way), thought asking for $2k funding from DHF, to buy a laptop was a good idea. The funny thing is, the user has been on Hive for 9 years and the proposal was written to make you understand *no laptop, no work*. Kind of like a blackmail to me and not only to me. Living off Hive is not new, so many have been and are sill doing it. Over the years I've seen so many users from countries where a few dollars can buy quite a lot, think they can get rich by blogging. Those dreams are long gone as reality has kicked in and when the price of a toke goes from $3.4 to $0.06, you need to wake up and realize you won't be a millionaire this way, especially if you follow the path of this person. ![jakub-zerdzicki-UaylYFMAhWk-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23xAq1LgQaXUpPsC1atyCTo8xTreMFgHorYc2xfMPmcMX7KtSCu3gHAPFQHRSMB1qk1m8.jpg) Photo by Jakub Żerdzicki on Unsplash Some of them think using some shortcuts could help you achieve more and this is when you see them posting about their life problems, like grandma needs new glasses, so funds needed is $100. Next time mom got her documents stolen, funds needed is $50 and so on. All this while they post about boat trips and eating sushi in a country where you don't even have the basics, inflation is sky rocketing and electricity is rare like a white crow. Everyone is given the same chance on Hive. Free account, no investment asked and you can grow your account if you're serious about it, like so many here have been doing. Don't get me wrong, this guy did everything he could, I have to give him that. He was caught plagiarizing, then he was part of the Vibe scandal, then he posted a bunch of test comments, which would not be a problem as one has to test the app they are working on, but he thought why not upvote these spam comments and make some money. Then came the laptop proposal. ![lilia-maria-slCzc9QPHVI-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23vsjJY6yEWQgSiorjwtNWeu6vbPqjv3rZjSkGiz6WzyL3Wr3P616u5dSTavVNzMzSpA9.jpg) Photo by Lilia Maria on Unsplash The funny thing is, that it's possible to get a laptop funded on Hive, it's not unprecedented, we had a case, but a very different one. A few years ago the community came together to help someone who lost everything, was on the streets with no money, no food, no shelter and no hope to even get a roof over their head for the night. It's possible, but not for everyone. This is a good community with a lot of good people, who are ready to help, if you deserve it. It seems like the DHF has become (or has been, to be precise) the milking cow for so many and even though the community has voiced its opinion against it, the process of changing how things are done is slow (I'm trying to choose my words elegantly here). We've been throwing money out of the window for years, by funding projects that are pure waste of money. Accountability seems to be a word in the dictionary and nothing more. In any normal company these project managers would not only have been fired but sued as well for damages, but that's a story for another day. ![julian-rosner-uDrWDhyOhow-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23vi1eCHa1umXzqPNvosjW5xPmkG2dCJb7hM38rkZm1rcV7kS67xX6suaXNNEaKsk37i5.jpg) Photo by Julian Rösner on Unsplash This "grab what you can an run" mentality can only take you so far and too bad people don't see or don't want to see the meaning of building. You have the chance to treat your Hive account as a saving account, grow it to have when the time comes, but it's easier to just walk the selfish path and help no one but yourself.
If you're a newbie, you may want to check out these guides: - [Communities Explained - Newbie Guide](https://peakd.com/hive-174578/@erikah/communities-explained-newbie-guide) - [Cross Posting And Reposting Explained, Using PeakD](https://peakd.com/hive-174578/@erikah/cross-posting-and-reposting-explained-using-peakd) - [Hive Is Not For Me](https://peakd.com/hive-150329/@erikah/hive-is-not-for-me) - [How To Pump Your Reputation Fast - Newbie Guide](https://peakd.com/hive-150329/@erikah/how-to-pump-your-reputation-fast-newbie-guide) - [Tips And Tricks & Useful Hive Tools For Newbies](https://peakd.com/hive-150329/@erikah/tips-and-tricks-and-useful-hive-tools-for-newbies) - [More Useful Tools On Hive - Newbie Guide](https://peakd.com/hive-150329/@erikah/more-useful-tools-on-hive-newbie-guide) - [Community List And Why It Is Important To Post In The Right Community](https://peakd.com/hive-174578/@erikah/community-list-and-why-it-is-important-to-post-in-the-right-community) - [Witnesses And Proposals Explained - Newbie Guide](https://peakd.com/hive-150329/@erikah/wintesses-and-proposals-explained-newbie-guide) - [To Stake, Or Not To Stake - Newbie Guide](https://peakd.com/hive-150329/@erikah/to-stake-or-not-to-stake-newbie-guide) - [Tags And Tagging - Newbie Guide](https://peakd.com/hive-150329/@erikah/tags-and-tagging-newbie-guide) - [Newbie Expectations And Reality](https://peakd.com/hive-166408/@erikah/newbie-expectations-and-reality) - [About Dust Vote And Hive Reward Pool](https://peakd.com/hive-153850/@libertycrypto27/discover-hive-focus-on-dust-vote-hive-reward-pool-advices-for-new-users-cosa-sono-i-dust-vote-consigli-per-nuovi-utenti-engita), by libertycrypto27

Something to know about movies, TV shows and podcasts, you can add them manually! But you can also scrobble them on a few websites currently!

The most watched/rated movie lists take the average rating based on users inputs, for instance if I rate a movie 88 and @rishi556 rates it 99, it'll be shown as somewhere in between! 

This is what it looks like on snaps currently:

The next big addition has been 

### Leaderboards!

Top Scrobblers as well as top artists leaderboard, clickable to check their most scrobbled songs! 


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/acidyo/Enyo1UUVFNkwSgo5MLvyiQewaAUAq1KaVcp5Bf3i9hJn7s7aDJeM5aBca6yxCzNShio.png)

along with a top songs across all users as well as top discussed/timed commented songs. 

All songs clickable to take you to its youtube embed so you can instantly listen to it, check discussions/timed comments of it as well as potentially lyrics if we managed to fetch them! 

___

Let us know! 

For now I'll be focusing on some other projects moving forward!

Another quality-of-life release for Ecency Mobile is rolling out today. **3.5.5** sharpens up the parts of the app you touch every day: writing posts, dropping in images, reacting with emoji, and watching embedded videos. Here is what is new. ### Searchable emoji picker The emoji picker now has a search bar at the top. Type a name or alias and the list filters instantly, with a friendlier empty state when nothing matches. The picker itself is also faster, with a one-time dataset build at load and tuned list rendering so scrolling stays smooth even on older devices. Reactions in chat now route through this same centralized picker, so the experience is consistent everywhere you can drop an emoji. ### Clipboard image paste (iOS) Copy an image anywhere on your iPhone and Ecency will notice. When the editor toolbar detects an image on your clipboard, a small "paste image" chip appears that you can tap to drop it straight into your post, or dismiss if you do not want it. The chip re-checks when you switch back to the app, and you can also long-press the image button on the toolbar to paste. Behind the scenes images are converted and compressed before upload so you are not pushing oversized PNGs through the network. ### 3Speak player fixes Tapping a 3Speak embed inside a post now reliably opens the fullscreen video viewer, and the same improved tap handling applies to other non-YouTube inline videos. Less wrestling with the embed, more watching. ### Smoother input handling everywhere A large chunk of this release is invisible polish on text inputs across the app: login, register, beneficiaries, polls wizard, transfers, tag input, post description, quick post, and the markdown editor itself. Inputs are now ref-driven instead of state-driven, which means: * **Polls wizard**: no more jumpiness while typing options * **Search**: smoother, more responsive filtering as you type * **Numeric fields**: comma-to-dot normalization so European decimal entry just works * **Auto-correction and validation**: applied without fighting your cursor ### Other fixes and updates * Points screen fixes * Dropdown and options menu icons updated for visual consistency (horizontal dots replacing vertical) * Legacy `transfer_token` route normalized so older deep links keep working * New Crowdin translation updates across the app * `@ecency/sdk` bumped to 2.2.10 ### Get the update * Android: [https://android.ecency.com](https://android.ecency.com) * iOS: [https://ios.ecency.com](https://ios.ecency.com) * [Direct Android APK file](https://github.com/ecency/ecency-mobile/releases) * **Full changelog**: [3.5.4...3.5.5](https://github.com/ecency/ecency-mobile/compare/3.5.4...3.5.5) #### SHA256 checksums ``` e61ecf58ed90ba25c5fff3e5de53b26282105c79ae6ee99dba08a0adbb5993c1 Ecency-iOS.zip 45afa51153bddc14d5ab28e55f2fad0addd1b11eb2c3bab7eebc2105dced2f50 Ecency-APK.zip ``` As always, feedback and bug reports are welcome on [GitHub](https://github.com/ecency/ecency-mobile/issues) or in the Ecency Discord. --- >Often, a walk is a necessity, whether for oneself or for someone else. If it’s for oneself, it benefits both body and mind; if it’s for someone else, we help them to clear their thoughts and find peace when they need it. --- ![20260505_173354.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23xen8LTzbzxBPxRyA3AaAGZJewicoSAnMQ9Wyc9fAMT9PeFewS8oGrv9SXAGtmkHW68q.jpg) --- A week ago, my mother had an operation. It was a simple one, a common procedure, cataract surgery, but that doesn’t mean there wasn’t any nervousness, stress or worry involved. So, a few days beforehand, I invited her for a walk. One where she could focus on other things, breathe in the sea air and get a change of scenery. My aim was to take her mind off things for a few hours. >So I prepared some mate, a typical Argentinean herbal tea, packed everything we needed into a rucksack including a small apple cake and we took the bus. The plan was to reach the start of the path leading to the lighthouse, rest there for a while, drink mate, chat about anything and everything, and then walk along the sand, listen to the soothing sounds of the sea and have a lovely time. That day, when we found a place to sit, we saw a black cloud in the distance, which you can see in the photos, but which was much darker and denser when we got there. We sat down and looked it up online. There was a fire in an industrial estate in a town to the east, and the cloud was visible from the centre of Málaga. It was a huge fire, but the fire brigade managed to put it out. Little by little, the cloud dissipated. --- ![20260417_192908.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23qrDP2E9YknsAok4vvSe9NPZijjkxViRnDpjy1JF6V3hxpzqFDzz5XqfoEw7Yhk2cwDo.jpg) ![20260417_192852.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23rAxzW2Fatow5L7k97Ycxot2uix18PjybMcZttiFpNnUfuApVX5191RfmXzwc22xjF4k.jpg) ![20260417_192903.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/242hNH5v15xnW7FbbewNHp75D1G7Uw6Q4Ut8ZmqhLn7hoo5xihf9AeehXzPKM3tEqysWm.jpg) ![20260417_192919.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/243fk2U1crwwvsf4krUiFi9svQ5SPesUkeMcUN8mYuMRhjWQYYfJYxSabBEYdBh6r6uue.jpg) --- Meanwhile, we chatted and enjoyed the peaceful atmosphere. There were lots of people out for a stroll. The seafront promenade is the place of choice; it’s always a favourite with both locals and tourists alike, and at this time of year there are plenty of tourists, though I suppose there are always some. With so many festive seasons, combined with the summer and the beautiful beaches, there’s always a lot of tourism. After a while, we resumed our walk towards the sea, right where Malagueta Beach meets the Paseo de Levante, which in turn is the continuation of the Paseo de la Farola. There are so many paths to explore that there’s always a great opportunity for wonderful walks. --- ![20260417_193014.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23zvDSm6282uDXD9UzUkHo3S9w3Cn1tfkgwptzLHCQuXAh2pTs3Q88hRLSNox1UDhWJVn.jpg) ![20260417_193005.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23xAR8VorqcF9cnkaDXrpstgYWZs4Mn5W1wPc2FA16R6zfVfDGe2aLwjXMH9UudRDN5kG.jpg) ![20260417_193024.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23uFTZQqcBKFX6KKr7fxLdZq1fdFQANJocu5KuxKUxEJLhmMAGD3GxQEm2vZkvhZi97mJ.jpg) ![20260417_193100.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/242rkmiZVGVRDXi52tatuaLPR5JEe7cFfzA848ncx2PMNsckXpGRoz4euDMgeRL3XEcGj.jpg) --- The walk took us past rocks, sand and water, but above all, we admired the beautiful views. You could still see the dark cloud of smoke in the distance, but it was getting smaller and smaller. --- ![20260417_193139.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23zRvdqQuu9tsU237F4YBYJGmRQEFi3iHuxcXNLgWFVYBaeGtEsPAznN9DJBVWWoue6Yb.jpg) ![20260417_193148.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23yd1HDBj4buWbzFfcR6nDgCzvbVSoccUEKMSUYQAfwmqUSXjVbrGiRDDzmuaXMqZYMb8.jpg) ![20260417_193136.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23z7BUumuT7oRxL7tyLEfLBYv6asSNydDxN1AZ2och93xgnSzd6TEdPovcNB9CjmPajAw.jpg) --- You know I love paying attention to everything I see around me, and I couldn’t help but look at the moss on the rocks, its shapes, its size, and how the water left its foam on them. I’m a huge fan of watching the white sea foam, and it’s one of the things I love most to paint in my pictures when I paint the sea. That’s why every little wave that came in was an opportunity for a photograph. The sea is always an excellent subject for that. --- ![20260417_193043.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/245wHbQ6Nq8JU37AiJDhAXebbGb9UtFNHMiuPSkcpfPQXVj6UMEncE8sRhuF4nRJwttRW.jpg) ![20260417_193122.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23rAzyeYiuczFqTSUyMWJT5StXT2qXx6gtPPgARYRhSgKrYQoRMd8SHWp1onr6Brt8ZzH.jpg) ![20260417_193127.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23ynMvziWAdob35EzPAERZabW84DQEq4kZNo9skhbotvUm1SoHi9mAAaGK37m11Y8cHJ5.jpg) ![20260417_193112.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/2423qCERZZK7y8guFdozWTGLUTHGRJ1Ky5mVr8TkwZb9Va6YQz1G3qYgPyKTP8bXgoHjD.jpg) ![20260417_193214.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23v4PDthEpP6SJbpbAHoCJckTXGWV2JmoKxtUgVk7ZZuVtXPoQeuobYhZc8FSKMDeetLc.jpg) ![20260417_193223.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/244eAE3LyT2YTnzr31qFwnCjAHGU4X49xnYsmheUSBgwLcJGs3W5MjpcQHo4u1MogNWxu.jpg) --- Behind me stood the streetlamp, creating a beautiful scene, and ahead of me lay more and more foam. On one side of the promenade was the Levante, with its row of palm trees, and on the other side was the beach, where people were already enjoying the early spring sunshine. It was a perfect day. And best of all, my mother took my mind off things; I walked and could see her looking so calm. --- ![20260417_193254.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23uQvshT7RHZqJsVEZkYkoLap3DcaSgmHFWvyhY34xuVuSrwzia8QXLaT12g4n9h9Mbrq.jpg) ![20260417_193258.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23yws7HKGYEDrhDR2JwPBnznqa3M8cBexD4ctyoaFTWKrAfc54GCvcQpDcookiJTGyzfK.jpg) ![20260417_193302.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23ywmCy8GvUq6ZEsTJWdxUTNZeLG3arJdciwW5F1xUvcryyhcB4WFFGmhPA9cBXbyMzDN.jpg) ![20260417_193233.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/243BXdys7jvdg4Q7UYgwSdcBaFrbmTJYCBLBE2UAnBW8JjwNpoBhp8v6LnUti3qddb6sa.jpg) ![20260417_193151.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23xedokp33nj3vaFnGLasJy9FCVfe53ywkwC5YnGN9Y6Qy79zgai8dBFjeM9kuv1jp4xP.jpg) ![20260417_193201.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23z79K5vbyXFUrDkuimx6XGy37gjSkPGWyZLhWzvjo7mJjPZWguzBP66rmFgt3ZDMwnp9.jpg) --- Water always brings good energy and I believe it is healing; even its sounds calm a restless mind, and that is good for the body too. --- ![20260417_194434.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/245cUKjiqZTxb2er1PUBXtZuceyp8fCrZj5NLiS6aKTCjKD5szMfQ2yQkNaX5BmpWitf3.jpg) ![20260417_194441.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/241Et2ysBWBjHECPxgawwCYZzGUs5Vx6RGEVjdaPTbwyC6bcVEYaqnN2Mx7kaebQt1JQG.jpg) ![20260417_194529.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/241EvLY17ucQ8cVP7bdUvtRvgHVYtLHzQSqHs2GUkrAau6eg4Ve25JJveSWVctDDA6z18.jpg) ![20260417_201743.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23ywu7uL9UtqXXyzgx52FfTtwT1zEgCf2FxmuTmkHYM1MoQsx7cQ91mNovrC44ejBVL3N.jpg) --- The walk continued back along Pier One, watching as the sun was already bidding farewell to the city to bring energy elsewhere. The sun is another great source of energy and I always love feeling it on my face and enjoying its many benefits. --- ![20260417_201747.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/245cYZ8XQvbBeAUGMHzY3bFtuuTDV1ha9DmdHw3MnYVSTtRwp4xUHEYHJNAuwL21hWz81.jpg) ![20260417_202038.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/245myEfB7GVSCEomQ62htZkN3xSYWJNFFkMrxtjJwytzL4ZfPCkBLkn6TFbL9k6vjUXQG.jpg) ![20260417_201757.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/243qAqcWqatv7QvqEzHG1aMHRjjj3vRDeYJ7ygsudfAYKHe4UekXyFUFysxwiLYoqFwBf.jpg) --- What’s more, there are always large, beautiful ships to see there; I love ships and their reflections. The setting is one of the most beautiful in the city, with the castles in the background, avenues lined with palm trees, and the cathedral visible on the other side. A magical moment, where time stands still to offer us pure beauty. Thank you very much for joining me on this relaxing Wednesday stroll. Warm regards to you all. See you soon. Amonet. --- --- >All photographs are my own. ![Separador Amonet rosa.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/Eo45huwdpJdeDRRmb3tm3Sv7mxs8Uq3XUZDd5bjvGqBDKfDE5DLGQM1duXTEQQYhyjs.png)
